title: Putting NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning to the test
gist: A consultancy with early access tested a small open model on its own hardware across two engines, two chips and three workloads. It trained a purpose-built draft head and legal and healthcare adapters, and compared them with what ships in the box.
changes: Measured by someone other than the vendor. The custom-trained drafter only matched the one built into the model, while a domain adapter more than doubled accuracy on a legal task.
caveats: No numeric head-to-head for the two draft heads, no test of whether the adapters hurt speculation, and no frontier comparison. An early-access partner, so not fully independent.

numbers.metric: Legal task accuracy with a domain adapter
numbers.baseline: the same model without the adapter

bears_on.note: A cheap adapter more than doubled accuracy on a domain task, measured by a third party.
A drafter trained specially for the deployment did no better than the one shipped with the model.
